detail: 'CH3Cl' is chloromethane by formula but chloroform in this corpus (one paper entered twice, one curator writing CH3Cl and the other Chloroform for the same experiments). The two blocks disagree inside the frozen contract and both are reproduced as-is. detail: The frozen METAL block assigns one ionic radius per element symbol and ignores oxidation state (all bundle metals are Ln(III)). The archive resolves the radius per row from the oxidation state, which matters for U(VI) vs U(IV) and Pu(III/IV). This featurizer uses one radius per symbol to stay on the training encoding. MEASURED: only 15 auxiliary rows carry a per-row radius that differs from the pinned per-symbol value, so the encoding choice is nearly free here; 947 further rows have no per-row radius at all (unknown oxidation state) and are given the pinned value, which is what the frozen rows also receive.
